visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with long, wavy blonde hair holds a small red velvet jewelry box toward the camera, smiling widely and pointing at it with his right hand. He is standing on a weathered wooden deck adjacent to a vibrant turquoise swimming pool. Behind him, luxurious overwater villas and a clear blue sky are visible in a tropical resort setting. (2) The man turns away from the camera and walks toward a woman sitting on an orange and white daybed. He is wearing a white T-shirt with multiple circular anime character graphics on the back and bright blue shorts. He approaches her with the red box held behind his back. (3) He kneels on one knee in front of the woman, who is wearing an orange tube top and patterned shorts. He presents the open box, and the woman reacts with intense surprise and joy, placing her hand near her face. (4) A close-up shot reveals the ring inside the box is actually a silver paperclip bent into a ring shape. The man tries to put it on her finger. (5) The woman's expression shifts to anger; she pushes the man's chest with both hands. He loses his balance, stumbles backward, and falls into the swimming pool with a large splash. The woman stands up and walks away toward the villa interior.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The man has blonde wavy hair and wears a white graphic T-shirt with blue shorts. The woman has dark hair and wears a bright orange tube top with red/orange patterned shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A luxury tropical resort with wooden decks, overwater villas featuring thatched roofs, and a clear blue infinity pool merging with the ocean horizon.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A romantic, slow-tempo acoustic pop song begins, featuring a soulful male vocalist and clean acoustic guitar strumming. The mood is intimate and warm, with the music dominating the mix in a studio-clean recording. There are no ambient environment sounds. (2) The romantic song is abruptly cut off. A short, metallic spring-like 'boing' sound effect plays at a high frequency, signaling a shift to humor. This coincides with the reveal of the paperclip ring. (3) A loud, realistic splash sound effect with broadband white noise characteristics is heard as the man hits the water. This effect is sharp and prominent, masking all other audio for a split second. (4) High-tempo, brassy comedic music in a circus-style arrangement starts immediately. It features staccato rhythms and energetic percussion, emphasizing the slapstick failure of the proposal and the humorous tone of the video's ending.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Expectations -> Subversion -> Slapstick Payoff
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous social media skit that subverts the expectations of a romantic marriage proposal by revealing a fake ring and ending in slapstick physical comedy.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video follows a popular short-form trend of 'expectation vs reality' humor, utilizing synchronized music shifts to drive the emotional arc.
